reviews.t: Great polish. It has some major bling.
reviews.x: This polish is wonderful if you love a good glitter. As others have said, a colorful (or black) base is needed to make the sparkles shine. I do anywhere from 2-3 coats depending on how sparkly I want to be. I defintely recommend this polish.
Love it! The polish doesn't chip off easily and it's just what I was expecting. Shipping was fast and the packaging was secure. Thanks!

The glitter is suspended in very thick gel. It takes lots of coats and lots of drying time in between coats.  I did use a white base instead of the black soon. But it looks more like red, white and blue than whats in the picture.
This nail polish looks exactly like it does in the picture. It's beautiful and sparkly, I love it! Very glam!
It doesn't look like display picture but still cute and I like it. Good purchase.

I love the effects, however after many many tries, I could not get it to turn out like this picture with the shooting look. I put in over black and pink. I used one coat black 2 coats of the shooting star then a clear top coat that is called Rock,  I do have uv light but I found this to make it tacky and took longer to dry due to the heat. reviews.t: Its a cute glitter polish like the ones you see at your local drug store ...
reviews.x: Its a cute glitter polish like the ones you see at your local drug store it doesnt look like the one in the picture but thats obviouse its a clear over another base color! I like it! Its fun

Super pretty, stays on well.  I've already changed it up 3 times.  Once just alone and then I did teal underneath and then I did it with a dark rose.  The pic shows a black underlay, but it looks pretty no matter how you do it :)

reviews.t: Nothing like the photo don't bother buying
reviews.x: Very disappointed in product. Had to put on several coats to actually get a decent amount of glitter on. Put over another color and still looks nothing like the picture. Glad I only paid a few bucks for this. Going on the trash.

reviews.t: great nail polish have several of this brand
reviews.x: I love it..love the glitter and it shows exacatly what the picture is.

As someone else stated, this isn't gel. Didn't realize that until I started to use it, and used in conjunction with other gel polishes (base, color - black, this glitter polish and regular gel top coat). It worked with uv light and hardened. Very pleased with it! Just wish it didn't come up when I searched for gel polishes.

I have had so much fun with this.  As other reviews have stated, you need a darker base coat to get the best out of this polish.  I had on silver and used this over it.  It was fun and festive.  Great for a party.  THEN I tried it over a black base coat and WOW it was so cute.  My nails looked just like the seller photos.  A few tips that worked for me:  I found that letting my base coat still be a little tacky, not completely dry, helped the sparkles grab better instead of sliding towards the t

As someone else stated in their review, I too expected a gel polish because this product showed up within my search along with several gel polish options. I liked the color and chose it without question. Regular polish never lasts more than a few days for me so I'm disappointed but that's my only complaint...it's a nice color.

Great color and it applies great. Not the color they show in the description, but that's ok because I ended up loving the color anyway. This is a picture of how it looks with no solid color as a base.
Polish is as advertised.  I use this quite often on my nails, continually look at  my nails and even my husband likes it also.  Arrived safely since it was wrapped very well.  Would order again.

reviews.t: Nice color, but not what is advertised
reviews.x: From the way the picture looked i thought this was a black nail polish with the glitter in it. It is actually a clear polish with a faint trace of pink

reviews.t: Pretty polish, I was disappointed because I thought it ...
reviews.x: Pretty polish, I was disappointed because I thought it was a uv gel polish (that is what I searched for). But still looks nice.
Actual polish looks nothing like the picture. Brown metallic hue with confetti glitter.

reviews.t: It's a party!  And SO hard to remove!
reviews.x: This is a nice change of pace option.  Looks good with the pink base I used. Needs a top coat or else it leaves a rough surface with the glitter. Stayed on well and didn't chip for close to two weeks.  UPDATE: I'm editing this a month later.  Still think it's beautiful and fun, but it's so hard to get off I won't use it again unless it's a VERY special occasion. I had to SOAK my fingers in polish remover several times for several minutes to slowly get it off.  And that was a problem because that

I don't know why everybody is complaining that it takes three coats of the glitter over black polish to make it look good and then it takes forever to dry. I had no troubles. I used to coats and a top coat of a super shine fast drying polish over it and it took less than 10 minutes to dry

not quite what I expected - I should read the details better!  That said, I really like this polish.  I assumed it had the black base shown, which it doesn't.  It's clear with all the glitter, so you can put it on to be as sparkly as you want!  Very happy with it.

reviews.t: A few caveats to get your nails to look like featured image
reviews.x: It is a clear polish, so if you want your nails to look like the item picture, paint your nails first. And you would have to do multiple coats to get as thick of an effect as the featured picture too. But I have been very happy with the product!
Just painted my toenails w SH Black Out & topped it with the featured polish. Went on easily, painted 2 layers & loving the sparkles!

reviews.t: the strong odor from this nail polish was too much ...
reviews.x: the strong odor from this nail polish was too much. Also it did not go on the nails as it showed in the picture.  I got rid of it.
This is NOT a gel polish, even though the description states it is.  Shame on you.

claims.text: Many reviewers love the sparkly, glamorous look of this glitter polish and would recommend it.
Several reviewers note the polish looks different from the product photo, though some still like it anyway.
Reviewers say a dark or colored base coat is needed to make the glitter really shine.
Some reviewers complain it requires multiple coats and long drying time to build up enough glitter.
A few reviewers were disappointed it is regular polish rather than gel as they expected.
